If sentiment is positive in the last 3 days and forecast is trending down, increase the forecast by 1–2% for the next 3 days.  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% for the next 3 days.  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is below 65, add 0.5–1.5% to forecast for mid-horizon (days 10–20).  
If sentiment is positive and forecast is above 70, cap forecast at +1% above current for late horizon (days 20–30).  
If sentiment is negative and forecast is above 70, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for late horizon (days 20–30).  
If sentiment is neutral and forecast is above 65, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid-horizon (days 10–20).
